project_name: Erdős 886: divisors in short intervals above √n

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos886.Erdos886Divisors
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos886.Erdos886Divisors (n : Nat) (ε C : Real) : Finset Nat :=
  fun n ε C =>
  Finset.filter
    (fun d =>
      And (LT.lt (HPow.hPow (↑n) (1 / 2)) ↑d)
        (LT.lt (↑d) (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (↑n) (1 / 2)) (HMul.hMul C (HPow.hPow (↑n) (HSub.hSub (1 / 2) ε))))))
    (Nat.divisors n)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos886.Palomar.erdos_886.variants.rosenfeld_infinite
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos886.Palomar.erdos_886.variants.rosenfeld_infinite :
  Set.Infinite (Set.ofPred fun n => LE.le 4 (Finset.card (Erdos886.Erdos886Divisors n (1 / 4) 16)))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos886.Palomar.erdos_886.variants.rosenfeld_bound
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos886.Palomar.erdos_886.variants.rosenfeld_bound (C : Real) :
  GT.gt C 0 →
    Filter.Eventually
      (fun n =>
        LE.le
          (↑(Finset.card
              (Finset.filter
                (fun d =>
                  And (LE.le (HPow.hPow (↑n) (1 / 2)) ↑d)
                    (LE.le (↑d) (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (↑n) (1 / 2)) (HMul.hMul C (HPow.hPow (↑n) (1 / 4))))))
                (Nat.divisors n))))
          (HAdd.hAdd 1 (HPow.hPow C 2)))
      Filter.atTop

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos886.Palomar.erdos_886_iff_forall_pos_lt_quarter
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos886.Palomar.erdos_886_iff_forall_pos_lt_quarter :
